Privacy

What this site keeps.

The enquiry form sends your name, email, phone, city or ZIP, chosen service, and message to info@txlandscapeservices.com through FormSubmit. This website does not keep an account for you and does not sell that information.

FormSubmit may process the message so it can be delivered, and may email the office once to confirm the address.

Do not send payment details or other sensitive records through the form. Questions: info@txlandscapeservices.com or 469-455-9733.
